title.zh: Pentagon bans US forces from using military info to bet in prediction markets
title.en: Pentagon bans US forces from using military info to bet in prediction markets

current_state.zh: Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth issued a memo prohibiting all Department of War personnel from using classified or nonpublic information to place wagers on military actions via prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket, citing operational security and judgment risks.
current_state.en: Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth issued a memo prohibiting all Department of War personnel from using classified or nonpublic information to place wagers on military actions via prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket, citing operational security and judgment risks.
